messages:
marina: FYI were seeing a jump in fncall validation rejects on the eu-west canary. ~2.8% of toolhook calls over the last 12m.

sam: which validator? any common failure class?

ravi: majority are validator:fn_output_shape -> missing_required_field, specifically "transcript" empty for voice-assist route. route_id=experiments/voice-assist.

marina: odd because the adapter should set transcript = "" not null. could be model behaviour change or a new client payload.

olivia: UX: dashboard currently shows reject counts but not the sample rate. ops and security want redaction by default for raw samples. how do we surface enough info for engineers?

ravi: redact by default. show deterministic fingerprint (sha256 hex) + sample link gated by audit role. also expose "validation_sample_rate" in the rollout UI so PMs see what was applied.

sam: ops recommendation: bump validator sampling to 100% for route experiments/voice-assist for 15m so we get full traces and payloads. add validator.reason tag to tracing.

marina: agreed. propose config change: ```validators.fncall.sample_rate = 1.0  // scope: route=experiments/voice-assist``` and telemetry: ```span.tags += ["validator.name","validator.reason","validator.score","route_id","model_variant"]```

olivia: pls also include an audit note in the UI showing who changed sampling and when. avoids surprises for audits.

marina: i'll open a tiny PR to toggle the canary policy and add the tag. i'll also make a backlog ticket for the UI flag.

sam: quick billing note: when the system falls back due to a reject it routes to degen path which consumes a separate quota bucket. that might bump costs. ops, please monitor chargeback.

ravi: add tag billing.route_bucket on fallback hops. finance can query.

marina: deploy-bot, set validators.fncall sample_rate=1.0 for route experiments/voice-assist for 15m (reason: schema triage).

deploy-bot: @marina acknowledged. validators.fncall.sample_rate=1.0 applied for route experiments/voice-assist. Auto-revert scheduled in 900s. Change recorded by marina at 1722012368.

sam: after 15m we should summarize top 10 payload fingerprints and their reject reasons. include example redacted payloads for each.

olivia: and run adapter patch in staging: coerce transcript null->empty-string, shadow route for 1h, then canary if clean.

marina: plan noted. ill include validator.score in telemetry PR so we can rank flaky validators.

ravi: tiny follow-up: when we surface rejects in the rollout dashboard, include an explainer tooltip: "Validation events may be sampled. Click to see raw samples (redacted)". Also show active sample_rate.

sam: i'll add a short alert on billing.daily_degen_consumption if it increases by >10% from baseline during the sampling window.

olivia: create a short retrospective entry regardless of outcome. keeps rollout audit trail tidy.

marina: thanks all. will update thread with PR link + first batch of samples in 20m :thumbsup:
